saw_lines: Furniture is a big, slow purchase, so buyers check delivery and the seller before they trust a price tag.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where delivery either answers the doubt or the buyer leaves.
Your site explains delivery, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping. Open new ads with the delivery time and free delivery minimum for new buyers.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: Your site explains delivery on its shipping page, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Buyers weighing a dining table check delivery before they click. Open new ads with the delivery time for new buyers.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a first time buyer only sees the discount. Furniture buyers want trust before paying. Collect one real number, like orders shipped, and open new ads with it.
Learn more sits on 28 of 30 ads, and they land on store pages and a map, with no product in view. Set the button to Shop now and send the ads to product pages, starting with the dining table.
Your 30 ads run on Facebook and Instagram at once, so spend may sit in the weaker feed. Run the best ads on Facebook alone and on Instagram alone, then keep the stronger placement.
